video_title: Joey Bada$$ - Eulogy (Official Video)
text:
This Joey Bada$$ track is a masterclass in lyricism. The way he crafts his bars is like poetry in motion—layered, articulate, and dripping with intention. It’s the type of writing that demands respect because it’s not dumbed down or spoon-fed for people outside the culture. Joey is speaking to us, not diluting the message to make it digestible for people who don’t get the depth of what hip hop really is. In an era where so many rappers are putting out nursery rhyme level bars, watered down and sounding like it was written in crayon, Joey reminds us what grown man rap sounds like.

That said, while the beat is definitely tough and carries some weight, it feels a bit too down tempo. Don’t get me wrong, it’s got that gritty vibe, but the pacing holds the track back from reaching its full potential. For me, those sharp, polished lyrics would hit even harder over a more up tempo, boom bap type beat with a chill but gritty edge. Something with a bit more bounce and urgency would let the words breathe and cut through in a way that would elevate the track as a whole.

At the end of the day, this song is still a reminder of what hip-hop can be when the pen game is on point. Joey’s in a different lane, and this is a reminder of why he’s one of the best doing it.
